subject: Clarify mid-month migration snapshot coverage and evidence for SOC 2 period
messages:
From: Isabel Torres <isabel.torres@audits-r-us.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmeco.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme SOC 2 period — mid-month migration / point-in-time evidence question

Hi Dylan / Marissa,

We're preparing Acme's SOC 2 Type II review and they flagged a mid-period infrastructure migration that took place on 2026-10-15. Two quick clarifications we need to document for the report: 

1) For the audit period you provided (2026-09-01 to 2026-10-31), do your point-in-time captures count the full calendar day for a given date in UTC (i.e., 2026-10-15 = 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T23:59:59Z) or do you use a different cutover instant/timezone?

2) During the migration on 2026-10-15, were there any planned downtime windows or rehosts that would cause gaps in the logical audit trail between the pre-migration and post-migration environment? If so, please provide the start/end times (timezone) and a short summary of what was migrated (services/components).

3) We will likely ask for a bridge letter if the migration changed the surface area of control coverage for that particular day. Can you confirm whether you can provide: (a) a signed bridge letter covering 2026-10-15 describing the migration impact, and (b) supporting evidence (daily snapshots, config exports, auth logs) that show continuity for that date?

Deliverables and timeline requested by Acme: evidence bundle and signed bridge letter by 2026-11-18. If you need more time let us know and we can adjust audit schedules, but please advise asap.

Thanks,

Isabel Torres
Senior Lead, IT Audit
Audits-R-Us

Attachments: none in this message
From: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Isabel Torres <isabel.torres@audits-r-us.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 period — mid-month migration / point-in-time evidence question

Thanks Isabel — looping in Compliance (Marissa) and Infra (Neha / Karthik) to confirm details and assemble evidence. Quick notes from my side: 

- We operate our daily point-in-time snapshots at 00:00 UTC by default for audit artifacts, and our retention policy records a full-day set of logs tied to that date (i.e., a 2026-10-15 capture should represent events occurring during that UTC day).
- The migration on 2026-10-15 was a regional rehost for a small subset of customer-facing inference workers (no customer data migration was performed; KV caches were warmed). There was a short maintenance window for the rehost; I don't have the exact start/end times handy.

Marissa / Neha / Karthik — can you confirm the UTC inclusivity semantics and whether we have a snapshot that captures both the pre- and post-migration state for 2026-10-15, plus the specific maintenance window times? Also, if we can draft a bridge letter and an evidence index that maps artifacts to common SOC 2 control families, that should satisfy Acme.

I'll stand by to coordinate signatures and packaging.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Isabel Torres <isabel.torres@audits-r-us.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 period — mid-month migration / point-in-time evidence question

Hi Isabel / Dylan,

Apologies for the delay — below is a consolidated response and the deliverables we will provide. I have attached a bridge letter draft (bridge_letter_draft.docx), an evidence index (evidence_index_oct15.csv) and a snapshot matrix (snapshot_matrix_2026.xlsx) to this thread. Links to the shared evidence folder are also included.

Responses: 

1) Snapshot inclusivity and timezone
- Our audit artifact captures are performed daily at 00:00:00 UTC. For SOC 2 purposes we treat the calendar day in UTC as inclusive; therefore 2026-10-15 covers 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-15T23:59:59Z. The snapshot at 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z captures the state at the beginning of the day; we also keep rolling operational logs indexed by UTC timestamp that span the entire day.

2) Migration specifics and potential gaps
- Migration summary: On 2026-10-15 between 02:30 UTC and 03:05 UTC we performed a controlled rehost of the EU-West inference worker pool for a subset of routes; this was a rolling migration with no full-service downtime. KV cache warming and a brief circuit flip occurred for 3 instances.
- Continuity: Because the migration was rolling and stateless for customer payload persistence, there is no gap in authentication or authorization logs; operational logs show handoff events and instance termination/creation records. We will provide the instance lifecycle logs and the rehost job runbook as part of the evidence bundle.

3) Bridge letter and evidence package
- We can provide a signed bridge letter acknowledging the migration and attesting that the change did not remove covered controls for the audit period. Draft attached; please review the phrasing in section 2 (migration scope) and suggest edits.
- Evidence to be included: daily snapshots (filesystem/config export), auth & access logs, orchestration job logs (start/end times), deployment manifests, and a mapping to common SOC 2 criteria. See evidence_index_oct15.csv for the mapping.

Timeline and next steps:
- We will upload the evidence bundle to the shared Drive folder by close of business 2026-11-16 (link below).
- We aim to deliver a signed bridge letter by 2026-11-18. If Acme requires an earlier signature, please tell us ASAP.

Shared folder (read-only link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cExampleEvidenceLink

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bridge_letter_draft.docx (draft), evidence_index_oct15.csv, snapshot_matrix_2026.xlsx
From: Isabel Torres <isabel.torres@audits-r-us.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: security@acmeco.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 period — mid-month migration / point-in-time evidence question

Marissa / Dylan,

Thank you — this is exactly the level of detail Acme's audit team needs. A couple of quick follow-ups before we close out the request: 

- Can you include a brief appendix in the bridge letter that lists the exact maintenance window times in both UTC and Acme's local timezone (America/New_York)?
- Please confirm that the evidence bundle contains a checksum (SHA256) for the key artifacts (snapshots and log bundles) so our intake team can validate integrity after download.

If you can provide the updated bridge letter and the evidence bundle with checksums by end-of-day 2026-11-18, we will not require any further clarifications. Otherwise we may request a short extension.

Regards,

Isabel Torres
Senior Lead, IT Audit
Audits-R-Us

Requested deliverables recap: signed bridge letter (with appendix showing maintenance window in UTC & America/New_York), evidence bundle (snapshots, orchestration logs, auth logs), SHA256 checksums for artifacts — due 2026-11-18.
